sonnet.problem: The card says "Food's running out. So a man from Bethlehem... goes to live somewhere else." The "So" makes the famine the reason for the move. Ruth 1:1 only says there was a famine and that the man went to reside in Moab. It never gives the reason.
sonnet.rule: Reasons: He never adds why someone did, said or thought something unless the text says why.

sonnet.problem: The question says Naomi "sees that Ruth is determined to go with her." That setup makes "She stops trying to persuade her" the obvious answer. It rules out the wrong answers, "She sends her back after Orpah" and "She tells her to wait in Moab".
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.

sonnet.problem: The card tells Ruth's vow about where she will die and be buried, and it carries a joke about phone-contract commitment. A card that tells death is supposed to have no joke.
sonnet.rule: Heavy moments. A card that tells death, violence, abuse, serious sin or the body's private matters has no joke.
